title: Fan Cowl Latch Assembly — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of a fan cowl latch assembly with the over-centre setting, the flag deployment check at three latch positions and the mixed installation prohibition that applies to the flagged latch standard.

sections.purpose: To install a fan cowl latch assembly, set the over-centre position and prove the unlatched indication where the flagged latch standard is fitted.
sections.job_setup_note: Both fan cowls must remain open and supported until the latch installation is complete. The over-centre setting gauge must be available. Where the flagged latch is being installed, both latches on the cowl must be to the same standard; a mixed cowl is prohibited and placarded. Two persons are needed.
sections.procedure: Make sure that both fan cowls are open and supported on their hold-open rods. Remove the temporary aperture cover. Clean the latch aperture and the pivot bore. Examine the aperture edge protective finish and re-protect any local damage. Install the shroud kit AR674643-02 and the nozzle assembly CAD746437-78 where the flagged standard is being fitted. Install the new seal D7110121607820 in the aperture. Put the latch assembly in position, install the pivot bolt with the washers EN17059-86 and torque to 18 Nm. CAUTION: DO NOT TORQUE THE PIVOT BOLT BEFORE THE LATCH HAS BEEN CHECKED FOR FREE MOVEMENT THROUGH ITS FULL TRAVEL. A TIGHT PIVOT WILL HOLD THE HOOK SHORT OF OVER CENTRE. Set the over-centre position with the gauge to the value in the acceptance table, or to the value recorded at removal. Install the shorter clamp and reposition the nozzle sub-assembly D7110129326915. Close the cowl and latch it. Check the flag at the fully latched position and confirm that it is stowed and flush. Open the latch one detent and confirm that the flag is fully deployed and visible from ground level. Release the latch fully and confirm the same. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE HOLD-OPEN RODS UNTIL BOTH LATCHES ON THE COWL HAVE PASSED THE FLAG CHECK.
sections.close_out: Apply the placard prohibiting a mixed latch installation on one cowl where the flagged standard has been fitted. Remove the cowl support trestle and the hold-open rods. Close both fan cowls and check every latch from ground level. Remove the warning notices, the placard for a removed latch and the safety barriers. Record the installation, the over-centre setting and the three flag check results.

type_data.effectivity_note: Flag deployment steps apply to aircraft post MOD-111337 only

safety_precautions: Do not release the hold-open rods until both latches on the cowl have passed the flag check.
Keep both fan cowls supported until the installation is complete.
Placard a cowl that carries the flagged standard against mixed installation.
